levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Checks only some ingredients, missing an obvious gap.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Checks every ingredient on the draft plan.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Checks every ingredient and proactively names a backup for a likely-missing item.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Revised plan still includes an unavailable ingredient.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Revised plan only uses available ingredients.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Revised plan uses available ingredients and the learner explains their substitution reasoning.

lookFors: Every ingredient from the first draft appears in the check, addressed one way or another.
Final plan is realistic and usable, not aspirational.
Reflection names a specific planning habit, not a vague intention.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
